description: This source file implements a Redis-backed semantic cache for large language model responses. It uses vector similarity to find semantically similar prompts and cache responses accordingly, with both synchronous and asynchronous methods. It also integrates with RedisVL's SemanticCache and supports embedding generation via a specified model.
